rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a man working behind a bar; Cantonese normally leaves the male gender implicit.

example.english: The barman at that bar is very good at looking after customers.
example.traditional: 嗰間酒吧個酒保好識招呼客人。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 zau2 baa1 go3 zau2 bou2 hou2 sik1 ziu1 fu1 haak3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a trained bartender whose job focuses on mixing drinks or cocktails.

example.english: The barman at this bar knows how to mix lots of special drinks.
example.traditional: 呢間酒吧嘅調酒師識調好多特飲。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zau2 baa1 ge3 tiu4 zau2 si1 sik1 tiu4 hou2 do1 dak6 jam2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on a male bar attendant or server rather than specifically on mixing drinks.

example.english: The barman came over to take our order.
example.traditional: 酒吧侍應過嚟幫我哋落單。
example.jyutping: zau2 baa1 si6 jing3 gwo3 lei4 bong1 ngo5 dei6 lok6 daan1
